description: Set tab stops on the paragraphs of the chosen text (Type > Tabs): add or replace stops with alignment (left, centre, right, align on a character), leader and align-on character; delete stops; clear all; repeat a stop across the column (Repeat Tab); or list them. Positions are mm from the left edge of the text column

action.description: add stops, replace all stops, delete stops at positions, clear all stops, repeat a stop, or list stops

positions.description: For delete: positions (mm) of the stops to remove

repeatIndex.description: For repeat: which stop to repeat (0-based; default the last)

tabs.description: For add and replace: stops as { position (mm), alignment (LEFT_ALIGN, CENTER_ALIGN, RIGHT_ALIGN, CHARACTER_ALIGN), leader (up to 8 characters, e.g. "."), alignOn (the character a CHARACTER_ALIGN stop aligns on, e.g. ".") }

text.description: Which text to act on. Give text frame ids, story ids, or selection: true; optionally narrow each to a character range (start/end) or a paragraph range (paragraphs)

end.description: Last character, inclusive (default: the end of the text)

ids.description: Text frame ids (PageItem.id); acts on the text in each frame, or its whole story with wholeStory

paragraphs.description: [first, last] paragraph indexes (0-based, inclusive) within each chosen text

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frames

start.description: First character (0-based, within each chosen text)

wholeStory.description: For frames and selected text, act on the whole story they belong to

until.description: For repeat: add stops up to this position in mm (default: the column width less the right indent)

name: set_tab_stops
title: Set Tab Stops
